turns.q: What did you do for White Paper?
turns.answer:
White Paper is the UK's leading provider of legal and business CPD conferences, and I've looked after their brand and platforms for a long stretch now. Most recently I designed and built their booking engine and on-demand video platform — cutting a long, error-prone checkout down to a few simple steps and pulling all their scattered conference data into one place.[[casestudies]]

The results were the part I'm proudest of: drop-offs fell dramatically and the on-demand side now brings in a real chunk of their revenue.

[[next: how did you cut down the checkout drop-off? @study:white-paper-booking-engine-design-development | what does your on-demand platform actually do? @study:white-paper-booking-engine-design-development | have you done similar work for other clients? @work]]

turns.q: What results did the booking engine deliver?
turns.answer:
The booking engine cut drop-offs by around 90% and reduced the number of interactions to book by 50–60%. On the back-office side, processing time dropped by about 85% — their admin team now spends roughly a fifth of their time on bookings, freeing them for higher-value work.

The MD reckoned it let them go from four back-office staff down to one, and the on-demand platform ended up accounting for about 35% of their revenue.[[testimonial]]
